what_happened: The design job "Design note: many agent slots, few build slots" was rejected at the final verdict. One of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet: that cargo test and cargo clippy still pass with the doc-only change. The verifier also raised one major finding: behavior criterion 8 is unmet because its evidence must cite commands that actually ran (D43), and none were cited. The event lists no failed checks and no other findings. The record does not say whether the commands were run or whether they would have passed. The record only shows that the evidence the criterion required was missing.
cause: A "tests and clippy still pass" criterion was attached to a doc-only design job. It can only be met by command evidence (D43), and nothing in the flow makes sure that evidence exists or is visible to the verifier. The reading adds the criterion by default. The producer is not told it must run and record the commands. The verifier cannot run them or see the producer's report, so it rejects the job on missing evidence even if the doc-only change broke nothing. Nothing checks, before the final verdict, that each behavior criterion has a demonstration that will leave observable evidence.
prevention: Add a code check before the final verdict. For every behavior criterion that names commands, it confirms the job's recorded checks include a run of those commands against the final tree, and it attaches that run record as the evidence the verifier sees. When the diff touches only docs, Athena should run cargo test and cargo clippy itself and record the results. Alternatively, it should state that the criterion is met by the recorded check run, so the verifier never has to rely on the producer's report.
proposed_request: Make "criteria that name commands" verifiable from recorded evidence. Outcome: when a job's acceptance criteria require commands such as cargo test or cargo clippy to pass, Athena runs them on the job's final tree and records the command, exit status and time in the job's check records. The verifier is shown those records, and a criterion that names commands is judged from them. A job whose diff touches only docs is not rejected for missing evidence when those recorded runs passed. Acceptance: (1) a doc-only job with passing recorded runs of cargo test and cargo clippy is not rejected on that criterion; (2) a job whose recorded run failed or is absent is still rejected on that criterion; (3) a test replays the rejected job 20261105-103606-svwx's criterion 8 against records with and without the runs and shows both outcomes.
